name: Cumsum

x.description: Input tensor, any shape (1D-4D). Supports float32, float16, bfloat16.

dim.description: int, dimension along which to compute cumulative sum.

y.description: Output tensor, same shape and dtype as input x.

description:
Cumsum: Returns the cumulative sum of elements along dimension dim.

torch.cumsum = cumsum(input, dim, *, dtype=None, out=None) -> Tensor

y_i = x_1 + x_2 + x_3 + ... + x_i (along dim)

Args:
    input (Tensor): the input tensor.
    dim (int): the dimension to do the operation over.

Keyword args:
    dtype (torch.dtype, optional): the desired data type of returned tensor. If specified, the input tensor is casted to dtype before the operation is performed. This is useful for preventing data type overflows. Default: None.
    out (Tensor, optional): the output tensor.

Example:
    >>> a = torch.randint(1, 20, (10,))
    >>> torch.cumsum(a, dim=0)
    tensor([13, 20, 23, 33, 46, 49, 64, 74, 83, 93])

Returns: Tensor, same shape as input.
